_comment: Loaded after config-mch.json and before config-site.json. Must be listed in
SPA_CONFIG_URLS or O3 will not read it (IMPLEMENTATION.md §7).
Random blood sugar history is read-only. Triage and OPD capture the value.
The O3 Record Vitals workspace is not given an input: its concept list has no glucose key.
mg/dL is CIEL 887 (Random blood sugar). mmol/L is CIEL 1458 (the same serum glucose in mmol/L).
Fasting blood glucose (CIEL 160912) is not this measurement.
